text: Ball seirc is an Irish mythological motif. It is a love spot on a hero's skin. The handsome hero Diarmait carried such a mark. The spot sat on his forehead or sometimes on his shoulder. Any woman who saw it fell in love with him. To live a quiet life he hid it under a fringe of hair or a cap. He showed the mark by accident while fighting a pack of dogs. The heroine Grainne spied it at that moment. She loved him at once. She then tricked Diarmait into fleeing with her.
